（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 18
Date 18-1-16
January 18th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that a code telegram has been received at
the Arsenal from Peking, saying that Yuan Shih Kai has received
a report from one of his personal detectives in Shanghai to
the effect that the rebels here will start trouble on the
19th or 20th instant.
Some time ago one of the gentry in Tsang Kuang Zah 張江文門
Pootung was empowered by the Central Government to collect land
tax at the rate of $2.40 per mow from the country people in his
district. A few days ago he started to collect the tax which
action was resented by the country people. As a result of the
trouble the day before yesterday a number of farmers attacked
the notable's house, and burned it to the ground. While this
was being done the local police arrived on the scene and had a
fight with the countrypeople, in the course of which one Constable
and one countryman were killed, and two policemen were wounded.
The trouble is not yet over, but troops are being sent to the
scene.
It is reported that the anti-monarchists intend to
assassinate Chief of Police Zee Koh Liang 徐國樑.
It is reported in rebel circles that Yuan Shih Kai has
spent $ 200,000.00 in organizing an assassination Corps and
that he intends to have all prominent anti-monarchists murdered.
This work will begin at once.
It is reported that the official astrologers in Peking have
told Yuan Shih Kai that the future emperor of China has been born
in Nanking. Yuan has been very upset since he heard this news
and he now suspects General Feng of Nanking and General Yang of
Shanghai of disloyalty. It is said that General Lieu who came
here a few days ago for the ostensible purpose of ascertaining
the attitude of the troops, really came to watch General Yang.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部）

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 18 号
日期 16-1-18
1916年1月18日

先生：

据报，兵工厂收到来自北京的一封密码电报，称袁世凯已收到其驻上海的一名私人侦探的报告，内容为本地的反叛者将于本月19日或20日发动骚乱。

前一段时间，浦东张江栅（Tsang Kuang Zah）的一位士绅获中央政府授权，向其辖区内的乡民按每亩2.40元的税率征收田赋。数日前，他开始征税，此举引起乡民不满。由于前日发生的冲突，一群农民袭击了该士绅的住宅，并将其焚毁。在此期间，当地警察赶到现场并与乡民发生搏斗，过程中一名巡捕和一名乡民死亡，两名警察受伤。骚乱尚未平息，军队正被派往现场。

据报，反君主制者意图刺杀警务处长徐国梁（Zee Koh Liang）。

据反叛者圈内消息，袁世凯已花费200,000.00元组建一支暗杀队，并打算将所有著名的反君主制者谋杀。此项行动将立即开始。

据报，北京的官方占星家告诉袁世凯，中国未来的皇帝已出生于南京。袁世凯自听到此消息后非常不安，目前他怀疑南京的冯将军和上海的杨将军不忠。据说，几天前以视察军队态度为名义来此的刘将军（General Lieu），实则是为了监视杨将军。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

警务处总监。
